=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:390-399 (also line 151, 716) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The expanding-command-word check (`_WORD_BEFORE_API_RE`, `_has_expanding_word_before_api`) runs only on raw text, so a quoted or spliced `api` after an expanding word (`$G "api"`, `$G 'api'`, `$G a''pi`) makes `_may_invoke_gh_api` return False and `evaluate` returns no decision.
  WHY: Bash expands `$G` to `gh` and strips the quotes, so `gh api` runs unguarded; the fix is to also test `_has_expanding_word_before_api(_normalize_for_gh_api_scan(command))` in both guard copies and add tests.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:143-146,390-399,564-571,1669-1673 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A global-flag spelling before the subcommand (`gh -R evil/repo api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/5/comments -f body=x`, `gh --hostname evil.example api ...`) is not recognized as a `gh api` call, so `evaluate` returns no decision.
  WHY: The command can target another repository or host without a prompt. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 dropped this finding, saying `gh` has no top-level `-R` flag.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1118-1124,1153-1161 (also 1103-1163, 1755-1760) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` does not treat backslash-newline as nothing, so `gh a\<newline>pi $EP` or `... -f body=$FIELDS` skips the word-splitting ask that plain `gh api` gets.
  WHY: The shell can supply arguments the hook did not check. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT with confidence 2 and no demonstrable bypass; luna rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash verified that the `$EP` form still ends in DECISION_ASK and dropped it.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:147-151,378-384,712-717 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_WORD_BEFORE_API_RE` is not tied to a command position or to `gh`, so `git commit -m "bump $V api docs"` or `echo "$NAME api"` is classified as a hidden `gh api` call.
  WHY: The command gets DECISION_ASK in every permission mode, which contradicts the module docstring that data-command text is ignored. It is a usability regression, not an allow.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
